The proposed summary incorrectly combines the restriction from subclause (I) ('not more than once during any 12-month period') with subclause (II). In the source, subclauses (I) and (II) are disjunctive alternatives separated by 'or', and subclause (II) explicitly permits inspection 'at any time with respect to records relating to a firearm involved in a criminal investigation that is traced to the licensee'. Imposing the once-per-12-month limitation on records covered by subclause (II) contradicts the statutory text.
